_doc: PLAN-019 audit baseline. Lessons here have KNOWN pre-existing drift found 2026-06-03 when audit_lessons.py began running the FULL lint (all sections) and the headless render gate over the whole corpus (the old audit only checked §1, hiding §2/§6/§7 and all runtime/layout drift). audit_lessons.py grandfathers these so the sweep is a REGRESSION gate: any NEW lint/render failure (slug not listed for that dimension) fails the audit; a listed slug that now PASSES must be removed (audit flags it). The lists only shrink. Per-lesson lint_lesson.py and render_check.mjs stay strict, so newly-authored lessons must be fully clean. Remediation tracked as the PLAN-019 follow-up batch.
